name: Aero 111

origin.basis: Continental's bicycle tires are marketed from its German site; Germany-made lines are marked 'Handmade in Germany'.

positioning: Aerodynamic race tire with vortex-generating tread cavities, developed with DT Swiss and Swiss Side.
hookless_note: Continental lists hookless maximum pressures: 73 psi for 26 and 29 mm, 65 psi for 32 mm.

wet_notes.summary: Continental claims exceptional grip in both wet and dry conditions.

availability.note: Listed in Continental's German and US catalogs; not found in Continental's official Tmall store on 2026-11-01.

caveats: Sizes are 26, 29 and 32 mm; measured width depends on the rim.
Not found in the official mainland China store; confirm a genuine source before buying there.

image.shown: Black Aero 111 as pictured on Continental's product page; the same picture covers every width.
image.alt: Continental Aero 111 road tire with black sidewall, angled product view

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list in a browser (the newest 15 per page when more exist; bundle pages that add inner tubes are not read), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Colour options on the same product page count as the same tire.

reports.summary: A quality tire that rides well; a bit tight to fit.
Easy to fit and seems fast after a month.
Awesome performance, but less puncture resistant than the GP5000 All Season, with more punctures in the wet.
